about.title: About me
about.p1: I am a Senior Fullstack Engineer and founder of the freelance studio Joys Lab (SASU). I just wrapped up a 30-month mission at Accor where I led the rewrite of the booking funnel (Vue 2 → Vue 3 / Nuxt 3) and built a dedicated Node.js BFF, as technical lead on front-end architecture and code quality.
about.p2: Versatile fullstack profile: Vue/Nuxt and React/React Native front-end, Flutter mobile, Node.js back-end (Express, Fastify, NestJS) and Laravel. I have tech-lead experience on multi-stack projects, with a strong testing culture (Vitest, Playwright), CI/CD and design systems.
about.p3: I have been shipping AI in production since 2024: RAG assistants, embeddings, prompt engineering and Python microservices. I run several SaaS in production and publish trimly, an open-source tool on npm. 15 years in field sales beforehand give me a genuine business sense.
